issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

embedMetadata.description:
Enable/Disable implicit filtering using the #fieldsToInclude
If set to true, the #fieldsToInclude will be included during vector store embedding creation.
An optional lambda {@link Genai.SourceCollection#syncMetadataLambda} can also be used to serialize the metadata which will be included in the embedding.

If this value is changed, all indexed {@link Genai.SourceFile}s will have to be re-indexed
to include/remove the metadata fields from the embeddings.

fieldsToInclude.description:
Fields to be included as a part of the vector store embedding.
If not specified, all fields in {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata} will be included in the embedding.

title: Config to define the behavior for implicit filtering for {@link Genai.SourceFile}s in vector store similarity search.
name: Genai.SourceCollection.Metadata.Config
